I wrote the calculator in C17 in `src/main.c`, and `build.sh` builds the optimized binary at `./app`. `node check.mjs` passes all 6 example cases.

I also tried some edge cases by hand, and all gave the answers the spec requires:
- **The smallest number:** `(-9223372036854775807 - 1) % -1` gives `0`. The typed literal `-9223372036854775808` is an `error`, because 9223372036854775808 on its own is too big. Dividing the smallest value by `-1` and negating it are both errors too.
